name: Hailblade
description: No jungle in this game: monster effects work on minions and Smite is this item's active. The item is not used up after 5 Smites - it keeps working while you own it.

passives.name: Sear
passives.description: Damaging a minion burns it for 60 (+30% AP, +5% bonus AD, +2% bonus health) magic damage over 5s.

passives.name: Scavenger
passives.description: Heal for 7% of the damage you deal to minions.

passives.name: Recoup
passives.description: Away from enemies (no enemy unit within 1000 range, standing in for the jungle), restore 8-18 (by level) mana per second.

passives.name: Huntsman
passives.description: Killing a melee minion (standing in for large monsters) grants 10 bonus experience.

active.name: Smite
active.description: Deal 450 true damage to an enemy minion or summon. After 5 Smites (counted on the slot) it becomes Chilling Smite: 900 damage, and on an enemy champion it deals 20-156 (by level) true damage and steals 20% move speed for 2s.
active.requires: not t_ward and (not t_champion or counter('hailblade_smites') >= 5)
